description: Figure 5 is a bar chart that illustrates the performance gain in percentage (+%) achieved by the VisuoThink model through the use of predictive rollout search, compared to its version without this feature. The chart displays the performance gain across different tasks, with the tasks listed along the horizontal axis and the performance gain in percentage along the vertical axis. The bars represent the performance gain for each task, with the height of each bar indicating the magnitude of the gain. The chart shows that the performance gain varies across tasks, with some tasks showing a higher gain than others. The specific values for each task are not provided in the caption, but the chart visually represents the relative improvement in performance due to the predictive rollout search. The caption also notes that the performance gain is calculated as the performance gap between VisuoThink with and without rollout search.
